name: Greater Cautery · Death
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 5.37-block radius for 18 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 3.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 12 s
• Growth: up to 10 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Withering: −1 ❤ per second for 9 s
• Life drain: 2.5 ❤ damage, you heal 1.5 ❤
